items.label: Add to cart
items.check: products can be added from product pages, category pages and search results; the count badge updates immediately.

items.label: Cart persistence
items.check: contents survive logout and return; guest carts persist via cookie or local storage for 30+ days.

items.label: Quantity updates
items.check: increase, decrease and remove all work, and totals recalculate instantly.

items.label: Out-of-stock handling
items.check: items that sell out while in the cart get flagged, checkout is blocked for them, and alternatives are offered.

items.label: Price change reflection
items.check: if a price changes mid-session, the cart shows the current price and warns the user.

items.label: Cart merge on login
items.check: a guest cart merges with the account cart on login; nothing is lost and duplicates combine quantities.

items.label: Cart limits
items.check: maximum item count or total value limits are enforced with a clear error message.

items.label: Guest checkout
items.check: purchase completes without an account; account creation is offered after, never forced.

items.label: Mid-checkout login
items.check: returning users can log in mid-flow without losing the cart and land back on the correct step.

items.label: Social login
items.check: Google, Apple and Facebook sign-in work and return to checkout without data loss.

items.label: Password reset
items.check: users can reset a forgotten password without leaving checkout; the reset email arrives within a minute.

items.label: Address validation
items.check: addresses verify against postal APIs, invalid ones get correction suggestions, PO boxes follow shipping rules.

items.label: Shipping methods
items.check: all options (standard, express, overnight, pickup) display with correct rates and delivery estimates.

items.label: Rate calculation
items.check: shipping costs match the carrier API, and free-shipping thresholds trigger at the right subtotal.

items.label: International orders
items.check: foreign addresses are accepted where supported, customs and duties are calculated or disclosed, country restrictions hold.

items.label: Address autocomplete
items.check: suggestions speed up entry and populate every field correctly.

items.label: Restricted products
items.check: hazmat and age-restricted items show warnings and can't ship to prohibited regions.

items.label: Jurisdiction rates
items.check: sales tax, VAT and GST calculate correctly per shipping address against current tax tables.

items.label: Tax on shipping
items.check: where applicable, shipping costs are taxed too; rules vary by jurisdiction, verify each one you sell into.

items.label: Tax-exempt orders
items.check: B2B customers with exemption status can buy tax-free; certificates are validated and stored.

items.label: Digital products
items.check: downloads, subscriptions and services follow their own tax rules, different from physical goods in many jurisdictions.

items.label: Tax visible before payment
items.check: the tax amount shows on the order summary before card details are entered; no surprise charges.

items.label: Coupon application
items.check: valid codes apply the right discount (percentage, fixed, free shipping); invalid or expired codes get clear errors.

items.label: Stacking rules
items.check: non-combinable coupons can't stack; where stacking is allowed, combined discounts calculate correctly.

items.label: Minimum purchase
items.check: threshold coupons only apply when the subtotal qualifies, checked after other discounts if configured.

items.label: Exclusions
items.check: category and product exclusions hold; discounts calculate only on eligible items.

items.label: Usage limits
items.check: single-use codes can't be reused, per-user limits hold, and total caps stop the coupon at the limit.

items.label: Automatic promotions
items.check: BOGO, free-gift and tiered discounts trigger on their own; no manual code entry needed.

items.label: Expired promotions
items.check: ended promos stop applying and no stale discount amount shows in the cart.

items.label: Card payments
items.check: Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover process correctly; card numbers are tokenized, never stored (see PCI DSS in References).

items.label: Digital wallets
items.check: Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal complete checkout in minimal steps, with shipping and billing populated from the wallet.

items.label: Decline handling
items.check: declined cards show the processor's reason, and users can retry with another method without re-entering shipping info.

items.label: 3D Secure / SCA
items.check: Strong Customer Authentication triggers when the issuer requires it; the challenge completes and the order processes.

items.label: Regional payment methods
items.check: methods display by user location: iDEAL in the Netherlands, Klarna in Scandinavia, PIX in Brazil, and so on.

items.label: Split payments
items.check: gift card plus credit card splits calculate correctly, and the gift card balance updates after purchase.

items.label: Refund flow
items.check: full and partial refunds process through the gateway and sync status back to the OMS.

items.label: Webhook handling
items.check: gateway webhooks (success, failure, dispute) are received and processed; idempotency prevents duplicate orders on retries.

items.label: AVS checks
items.check: billing address verifies against the card issuer; mismatches trigger review or decline per risk settings.

items.label: CVV required
items.check: CVV is validated on every card payment and failed checks block the transaction.

items.label: Velocity rules
items.check: repeat orders from the same IP, device or card in a short window get flagged.

items.label: Device fingerprinting
items.check: fraud services (Sift, Signifyd, Riskified) score device and behavioral signals; high-risk orders hold for review.

items.label: BIN country match
items.check: card BIN country compares against shipping and billing countries; mismatches trigger extra verification.

items.label: Confirmation page
items.check: shows order number, items, totals and estimated delivery after successful payment; printable.

items.label: Confirmation email
items.check: arrives within ~2 minutes with order details, tracking link where available, and a support contact.

items.label: SMS notification
items.check: if enabled, the confirmation text sends; opted-out users never receive it.

items.label: Order in account
items.check: the order appears in user history with the right status (pending, processing, paid).

items.label: Inventory decrement
items.check: stock drops by the purchased quantity, and out-of-stock alerts fire at zero.

items.label: ERP/OMS sync
items.check: order number, items, totals and customer data sync correctly to the order management system.

items.label: Session timeout mid-checkout
items.check: an expired session prompts re-authentication and preserves the cart.

items.label: Network drop during payment
items.check: on reconnection the system checks the payment status; no duplicate charges.

items.label: Concurrent checkouts
items.check: the same user on two devices produces one order, not two; the second attempt gets a clear message.

items.label: Browser back button
items.check: pressing back after payment doesn't resubmit; the user sees the confirmation or an "order already placed" message.

items.label: Empty cart
items.check: checkout can't proceed with an empty cart; the button is disabled or routes back to the cart.
